mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS event_id, e.name, e.lifecycle_status, e.start_date, e.end_date, e.place, e.event_type FROM events e WHERE e.space_id = #{spaceId}
SELECT count(*) FROM event_users eu JOIN events e ON e.id = eu.event_id AND e.space_id = eu.space_id WHERE eu.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT e.id AS event_id, e.name, e.lifecycle_status, e.start_date, e.end_date, e.place, e.event_type, e.space_id, s.name AS space_name, eu.role AS event_role, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM members m WHERE m.space_id = e.space_id AND m.user_id = eu.user_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS space_member FROM event_users eu JOIN events e ON e.id = eu.event_id AND e.space_id = eu.space_id JOIN spaces s ON s.id = e.space_id WHERE eu.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT e.id AS event_id, e.name, e.lifecycle_status, e.lifecycle_version, e.start_date, e.end_date, e.place, e.event_type, e.space_id, s.name AS space_name FROM events e JOIN spaces s ON s.id = e.space_id WHERE e.id = #{eventId}
